segments.source: Vectors
Learn how to add and scale vectors in <m>\R^n</m>, both algebraically and geometrically.
segments.translation: <m>\R^n</m>에서 벡터를 더하고 스칼라배하는 방법을 대수적으로, 그리고 기하적으로 익힙니다.

segments.source: Understand linear combinations geometrically.
Pictures: vector addition, vector subtraction, linear combinations.
Vocabulary words: vector, linear combination.
Vectors in <m>\R^n</m>
We have been drawing points in \R^n as dots in the line, plane, space, etc. We can also draw them as arrows.
segments.translation: 지금까지 \R^n의 점을 직선, 평면, 공간 등에 찍힌 점으로 그려 왔습니다. 이 점들을 화살표로 그릴 수도 있습니다.

segments.source: Since we have two geometric interpretations in mind, we now discuss the relationship between the two points of view.
segments.translation: 이처럼 기하적 해석이 두 가지 있으므로, 이제 두 관점 사이의 관계를 살펴보겠습니다.

segments.source: Points and Vectors
Again, a <term>point</term> in <m>\R^n</m> is drawn as a dot.

<latex-code>
              <![CDATA[
    \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1, every pin/.style={whitebg, thin border}]
    \draw[grid lines] (-1,-1) grid (4, 4);
    \draw[->, thick] (-1,0) -- (4,0);
    \draw[->, thick] (0,-1) -- (0,4);
    \point[seq-blue, pin={
      [pin edge={seq-blue}, text=seq-blue]
      -85:the point $(1,3)$}] (x) at (1,3);
    \end{tikzpicture}
              ]]>
        </latex-code>
        A <term>vector</term> is a point in <m>\R^n</m>, drawn as an arrow.
        <latex-code>
              <![CDATA[
    \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1, every pin/.style={whitebg, thin border}]
    \draw[grid lines] (-1,-1) grid (4, 4);
      \draw[thick vector, green!50!black] (0,0)
        -- node[midway, pin={[right]-10:the vector $1\choose3$}] {} (1,3);
  \end{tikzpicture}
              ]]>
        </latex-code>
segments.translation:
<latex-code>
              <![CDATA[
    \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1, every pin/.style={whitebg, thin border}]
    \draw[grid lines] (-1,-1) grid (4, 4);
    \draw[->, thick] (-1,0) -- (4,0);
    \draw[->, thick] (0,-1) -- (0,4);
    \point[seq-blue, pin={
      [pin edge={seq-blue}, text=seq-blue]
      -85:the point $(1,3)$}] (x) at (1,3);
    \end{tikzpicture}
              ]]>
        </latex-code> <term>벡터</term>는 <m>\R^n</m>의 점을 화살표로 그린 것입니다. <latex-code>
              <![CDATA[
    \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1, every pin/.style={whitebg, thin border}]
    \draw[grid lines] (-1,-1) grid (4, 4);
      \draw[thick vector, green!50!black] (0,0)
        -- node[midway, pin={[right]-10:the vector $1\choose3$}] {} (1,3);
  \end{tikzpicture}
              ]]>
        </latex-code>

segments.source: The difference is purely psychological: points and vectors are both just lists of numbers.
segments.translation: 둘의 차이는 순전히 심리적인 것입니다. 점과 벡터는 모두 수의 목록일 뿐입니다.

segments.source: Interactive: A vector in <m>\R^3</m>, by coordinates
A vector in <m>\R^3</m>, and its coordinates.
Drag the arrow head and tail.

When we think of a point in <m>\R^n</m> as a vector, we will usually write it vertically, like a matrix with one column:
    <me>v = \vec{1 3}.</me>
segments.translation: <m>\R^n</m>의 점을 벡터로 생각할 때는 보통 열이 하나인 행렬처럼 세로로 씁니다. <me>v = \vec{1 3}.</me>

segments.source: We will also write <m>0</m> for the zero vector.
A vector
The zero vector
Why make the distinction between points and vectors?
A vector need not start at the origin: it can be located anywhere!
segments.translation: 벡터는 원점에서 시작하지 않아도 됩니다. 어디에든 놓일 수 있습니다!

segments.source: In other words, an arrow is determined by its length and its direction, not by its location.
segments.translation: 다시 말해, 화살표는 위치가 아니라 길이와 방향으로 결정됩니다.

segments.source: Unless otherwise specified, we will assume that all vectors start at the origin.
segments.translation: 따로 언급하지 않는 한, 모든 벡터는 원점에서 시작한다고 가정합니다.

segments.source: Vectors makes sense in the real world: many physical quantities, such as velocity, are represented as vectors.
segments.translation: 벡터는 현실 세계에서도 의미가 있습니다. 속도와 같은 많은 물리량이 벡터로 표현됩니다.

segments.source: But it makes more sense to think of the velocity of a car as being located at the car.
segments.translation: 그런데 자동차의 속도는 자동차가 있는 위치에 놓여 있다고 생각하는 편이 더 자연스럽습니다.

segments.source: Some authors use boldface letters to represent vectors, as in <q><m>\mathbf v</m></q>, or use arrows, as in <q><m>\oldvec v</m></q>.
segments.translation: 어떤 저자들은 <q><m>\mathbf v</m></q>처럼 굵은 글자로 벡터를 나타내거나, <q><m>\oldvec v</m></q>처럼 화살표를 사용합니다.

segments.source: As it is usually clear from context if a letter represents a vector, we do not decorate vectors in this way.
segments.translation: 어떤 문자가 벡터를 나타내는지는 보통 문맥에서 분명하므로, 이 책에서는 벡터에 이런 표시를 하지 않습니다.

segments.source: Another way to think about a vector is as a difference between two points, or the arrow from one point to another.
segments.translation: 벡터를 두 점 사이의 차, 즉 한 점에서 다른 점으로 향하는 화살표로 생각할 수도 있습니다.

segments.source: Vector Algebra and Geometry
Here we learn how to add vectors together and how to multiply vectors by numbers, both algebraically and geometrically.
segments.translation: 여기서는 벡터끼리 더하는 방법과 벡터에 수를 곱하는 방법을 대수적으로, 그리고 기하적으로 익힙니다.

segments.source: Vector addition and scalar multiplication

We can add two vectors together:
          <me>\vec{ a b c} + \vec{ x y z} = \vec{ a+x b+y c+z}.</me>
          <idx><h>Vector</h><h>addition</h></idx>
segments.translation: 두 벡터를 더할 수 있습니다: <me>\vec{ a b c} + \vec{ x y z} = \vec{ a+x b+y c+z}.</me> <idx><h>Vector</h><h>addition</h></idx>

segments.source:
We can multiply, or <term>scale</term>, a vector by a real number <m>c</m>:
          <idx><h>Vector</h><h>scalar multiplication</h></idx>
          <me>\def\r{\textcolor{red}}
\r c\vec{ x y z} = \vec{ \r c\cdot x \r c\cdot y \r c\cdot z}.</me>
segments.translation:
벡터에 실수 <m>c</m>를 곱할 수 있으며, 이를 벡터를 <term>스케일링</term>한다고도 합니다: <idx><h>Vector</h><h>scalar multiplication</h></idx> <me>\def\r{\textcolor{red}}
\r c\vec{ x y z} = \vec{ \r c\cdot x \r c\cdot y \r c\cdot z}.</me>

segments.source: We call <m>c</m> a <term>scalar</term> to distinguish it from a vector.
If <m>v</m> is a vector and <m>c</m> is a scalar, then <m>cv</m> is called a <term>scalar multiple</term> of <m>v</m>.
Addition and scalar multiplication work in the same way for vectors of length <m>n</m>.
segments.translation: 덧셈과 스칼라 곱셈은 길이가 <m>n</m>인 벡터에서도 같은 방식으로 작동합니다.

segments.source: The Parallelogram Law for Vector Addition
Geometrically, the sum of two vectors <m>v,w</m> is obtained as follows: place the tail of <m>w</m> at the head of <m>v</m>.
segments.translation: 기하학적으로, 두 벡터 <m>v,w</m>의 합은 다음과 같이 얻습니다: <m>w</m>의 꼬리를 <m>v</m>의 머리에 놓습니다.

segments.source: Then <m>v+w</m> is the vector whose tail is the tail of <m>v</m> and whose head is the head of <m>w</m>.
segments.translation: 그러면 <m>v+w</m>는 꼬리가 <m>v</m>의 꼬리이고 머리가 <m>w</m>의 머리인 벡터입니다.

segments.source: Doing this both ways creates a parallelogram.
segments.translation: 이를 양쪽 순서로 모두 해 보면 평행사변형이 만들어집니다.

segments.source: Why?

segments.translation:
<m>v+w</m>의 너비는 각 너비의 합이며, 높이도 마찬가지입니다. <latex-code>
            <![CDATA[
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[grid lines] (0,0) grid (5,5);
  \fill[red!30, nearly transparent] (0,0) -- (1,3) -- (5,5) -- (4,2) -- cycle;
  \begin{scope}[thin border nodes]
  \draw[vector, seq-blue] (0,0) to["$v$"] (1,3);
  \draw[vector, seq-green] (1,3) to["$w$"] (5,5);
  \draw[vector, seq-green] (0,0) to["$w$"'] (4,2);
  \draw[vector, seq-blue] (4,2) to["$v$"'] (5,5);
  \draw[vector] (0,0) to["$v+w$" {sloped, pos=.6}] (5,5);
  \end{scope}
  \draw[|<->|] (0,5.5) -- (1,5.5);
  \draw[|<->|] (1,5.5) -- (5,5.5);
  \draw[|<->|] (0,-.5) -- (4,-.5);
  \draw[|<->|] (4,-.5) -- (5,-.5);
  \path (0,-.5) -- (5,-.5)
     node[pos=.5, font=\small, below=1mm] {$5 = 1 + 4 = 4+1$};
  \draw[|<->|] (5.5,0) -- (5.5,2);
  \draw[|<->|] (5.5,2) -- (5.5,5);
  \draw[|<->|] (-.5,0) -- (-.5,3);
  \draw[|<->|] (-.5,3) -- (-.5,5);
  \path (-.5, 0) -- (-.5, 5)
     node[pos=.5, font=\small, above, rotate=90] {$5 = 2 + 3 = 3 + 2$};
\end{tikzpicture}
            ]]>
      </latex-code>

segments.source: Interactive: The parallelogram law for vector addition
The parallelogram law for vector addition.
Click and drag the heads of <m></m> and <m>w</m>.
Vector Subtraction
Geometrically, the difference of two vectors <m>v,w</m> is obtained as follows: place the tail of <m>v</m> and <m>w</m> at the same point.
segments.translation: 기하학적으로, 두 벡터 <m>v,w</m>의 차는 다음과 같이 얻습니다: <m>v</m>와 <m>w</m>의 꼬리를 같은 점에 놓습니다.

segments.source: Then <m>v-w</m> is the vector from the head of <m>w</m> to the head of <m>v</m>.
Why?

segments.translation:
<m>v-w</m>를 <m>w</m>에 더하면 <m>v</m>가 됩니다. <latex-code>
            <![CDATA[
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[grid lines] (0,0) grid (5,5);
  \begin{scope}[thin border nodes]
  \draw[vector, seq-blue] (0,0) to["$v$"] (1,4);
  \draw[vector, seq-green] (0,0) to["$w$"] (4,2);
  \draw[vector] (4,2) to["$v-w$"' {sloped, pos=.7}] (1,4);
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
        ]]>
      </latex-code>

segments.source: Interactive: Vector subtraction
Vector subtraction.
Click and drag the heads of <m>v</m> and <m>w</m>.
Scalar Multiplication
A scalar multiple of a vector <m>v</m> has the same (or opposite) direction, but a different length.
segments.translation: 벡터 <m>v</m>의 스칼라배는 방향은 같지만(또는 반대이지만) 길이가 다릅니다.

segments.source: For instance, <m>2v</m> is the vector in the direction of <m>v</m> but twice as long, and <m>-\frac 12v</m> is the vector in the opposite direction of <m>v</m>, but half as long.
segments.translation: 예를 들어, <m>2v</m>는 <m>v</m>와 같은 방향이면서 길이가 두 배인 벡터이고, <m>-\frac 12v</m>는 <m>v</m>와 반대 방향이면서 길이가 절반인 벡터입니다.

segments.source: Interactive: Scalar multiplication
Scalar multiplication.
Drag the slider to change the scalar.
Linear Combinations
We can add and scale vectors in the same equation.
segments.translation: 같은 식 안에서 벡터를 더하고 스칼라배할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Let <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k</m> be scalars, and let <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_k</m> be vectors in <m>\R^n</m>.

The vector in <m>\R^n</m>
        <me>c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_kv_k
        </me>
        is called a <term>linear combination</term> of the vectors <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_k</m>, with <term>weights</term> or <term>coefficients</term> <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k</m>.
segments.translation:
<m>\R^n</m>의 벡터 <me>c_1v_1 + c_2v_2 + \cdots + c_kv_k
        </me>를 <term>가중치</term> 또는 <term>계수</term> <m>c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k</m>를 갖는 벡터 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_k</m>의 <term>일차결합</term>이라고 합니다.

segments.source: Geometrically, a linear combination is obtained by stretching / shrinking the vectors <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_k</m> according to the coefficients, then adding them together using the parallelogram law.
segments.translation: 기하학적으로, 일차결합은 벡터 <m>v_1,v_2,\ldots,v_k</m>를 계수에 따라 늘이거나 줄인 다음, 평행사변형 법칙을 사용하여 이들을 더해서 얻습니다.

segments.source: Let <m>v_1 = {1\choose 2}</m> and <m>v_2 = {1\choose 0}</m>.
Here are some linear combinations of <m>v_1</m> and <m>v_2</m>, drawn as points.
segments.translation: 다음은 <m>v_1</m>과 <m>v_2</m>의 일차결합 몇 가지를 점으로 나타낸 것입니다.

segments.source:
<latex-code>
            <![CDATA[
  \begin{tikzpicture}[thin border nodes]
    \draw[help lines] (-3,-3) grid (4, 4);
    \draw[->] (-3,0) -- (4,0);
    \draw[->] (0,-3) -- (0,4);
    \draw[vector, seq1] (0,0) to["$v_1$"] (1,2);
    \draw[vector, seq2] (0,0) to["\strut$v_2$"'] (1,0);
    \point at (0,0);
    \point[seq3] at (2,2);
    \point[seq4] at (0,2);
    \point[seq5] at (2,4);
    \point[seq8] at (2,0);
    \point[seq7] at (-1,-2);

    \node[anchor=west, overlay] at (5, .75)
      {
        \begin{minipage}{0.6\linewidth}
           \begin{itemize}
           \color{seq3}
           \item $v_1+v_2$
           \color{seq4}
           \item $v_1-v_2$
           \color{seq5}
           \item $2v_1\color{gray}+0v_2$
           \color{seq8}
           \item $2v_2$
           \color{seq7}
           \item $-v_1$
           \end{itemize}
        \end{minipage}
      };
  \end{tikzpicture}
            ]]>
      </latex-code>
      <idx><h>Linear combination</h><h>two vectors, picture of</h></idx>
      The locations of these points are found using the parallelogram law for vector addition.

segments.source: Any vector on the plane is a linear combination of <m>v_1</m> and <m>v_2</m>, with suitable coefficients.
segments.translation: 평면 위의 모든 벡터는 적절한 계수를 갖는 <m>v_1</m>과 <m>v_2</m>의 일차결합입니다.

segments.source: Linear combinations of two vectors in <m>\R^2</m>: move the sliders to change the coefficients of <m>v_1</m> and <m>v_2</m>.
segments.translation: <m>\R^2</m>에 있는 두 벡터의 일차결합: 슬라이더를 움직여 <m>v_1</m>과 <m>v_2</m>의 계수를 바꾸어 보십시오.

segments.source: Note that any vector on the plane can be obtained as a linear combination of <m>v_1,v_2</m> with suitable coefficients.
segments.translation: 평면 위의 모든 벡터를 적절한 계수를 갖는 <m>v_1,v_2</m>의 일차결합으로 얻을 수 있다는 점에 주목하십시오.

segments.source: Interactive: Linear combinations of three vectors
Linear combinations of three vectors: move the sliders to change the coefficients of <m>v_1,v_2,v_3</m>.
segments.translation: 세 벡터의 일차결합: 슬라이더를 움직여 <m>v_1,v_2,v_3</m>의 계수를 바꾸어 보십시오.

segments.source: Note how the parallelogram law for addition of three vectors is more of a <q>parallepiped law</q>.
segments.translation: 세 벡터의 덧셈에 대한 평행사변형 법칙이 오히려 <q>평행육면체 법칙</q>에 가깝다는 점에 주목하십시오.

segments.source: Linear Combinations of a Single Vector
A linear combination of a single vector <m>v = {1\choose 2}</m> is just a scalar multiple of <m>v</m>.
Linear Combinations of Collinear Vectors
The set of all linear combinations of the vectors v_1 = \vec{2 2} \sptxt{and} v_2 = \vec{-1 -1} is the line containing both vectors.
segments.translation: 벡터 v_1 = \vec{2 2} \sptxt{and} v_2 = \vec{-1 -1}의 모든 일차결합의 집합은 두 벡터를 모두 포함하는 직선입니다.

segments.source:
<latex-code>
            <![CDATA[
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw[grid lines] (-3,-3) grid (4, 4);
    \path[clip] (-3,-3) rectangle (4, 4);
    \draw[thin, seq4] ($-2*(2,2)$) -- ($2*(2,2)$);
    \draw[vector, seq1] (0,0) to["$v_1$" thin border] (2,2);
    \draw[vector, seq2] (0,0) to["$v_2$"' thin border] (-1,-1);
    \point at (0,0);
  \end{tikzpicture}
            ]]>
      </latex-code>
      The difference between this and a previous <xref ref="vectors-eg-lincombo-plane">example</xref> is that both vectors lie on the same line.
segments.translation:
<latex-code>
            <![CDATA[
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw[grid lines] (-3,-3) grid (4, 4);
    \path[clip] (-3,-3) rectangle (4, 4);
    \draw[thin, seq4] ($-2*(2,2)$) -- ($2*(2,2)$);
    \draw[vector, seq1] (0,0) to["$v_1$" thin border] (2,2);
    \draw[vector, seq2] (0,0) to["$v_2$"' thin border] (-1,-1);
    \point at (0,0);
  \end{tikzpicture}
            ]]>
      </latex-code> 이 경우와 앞의 <xref ref="vectors-eg-lincombo-plane">예</xref>의 차이점은 두 벡터가 같은 직선 위에 있다는 것입니다.

segments.source: Hence any scalar multiples of <m>v_1,v_2</m> lie on that line, as does their sum.
segments.translation: 따라서 <m>v_1,v_2</m>의 모든 스칼라배는 그 직선 위에 있으며, 이들의 합도 마찬가지입니다.

segments.source: Interactive: Linear combinations of two collinear vectors
Linear combinations of two collinear vectors in <m>\R^2</m>.
Move the sliders to change the coefficients of <m>v_1,v_2</m>.
Note that there is no way to <q>escape</q> the line.
